statement: TrendForce projects 44.6% ASIC growth versus 16.1% for merchant GPUs in 2026, with ASIC-based AI servers reaching 27.8% of the market and ASIC shipments projected to surpass GPU shipments by 2028 - an accelerating custom-silicon alternative to merchant GPUs.
why: Custom ASICs growing far faster than merchant GPUs and projected to overtake them expand alternative compute supply and threaten merchant-GPU share.

impact.mechanism: Faster ASIC growth and rising ASIC server share erode merchant-GPU share while expanding hyperscaler custom-silicon (alternative) supply.

evidence.excerpt: TrendForce projects 44.6% ASIC growth against 16.1% for merchant GPUs in 2026, with ASIC-based AI server shipments reaching 27.8% of the total market.

confidence.basis: Secondary opinion/analysis (faf.ae) citing a TrendForce projection; single publisher, capped at medium.
